target_moa.text: Eravacycline is a synthetic tetracycline-class (fluorocyclic) antibacterial that binds the bacterial 30S ribosomal subunit and inhibits bacterial protein synthesis; activity is bacteriostatic.

citations.quote: Eravacycline is a synthetic, broad-spectrum fluorocyclic antibacterial drug belonging to the tetracycline class
As a class, tetracyclines bind to the bacterial ribosome 30S subunit and inhibit bacterial protein synthesis. Activity is bacteriostatic.
Eravacycline (XERAVA™) is a synthetic tetracycline class antibacterial drug.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (incidence >=3%) were infusion site reactions (7.7% vs 1.9% comparator), nausea (6.5% vs 0.6%), and vomiting (3.7% vs 2.5%). Major risks include life-threatening hypersensitivity reactions, tooth discoloration/enamel hypoplasia, inhibition of bone growth, and C. difficile-associated diarrhea.

summary.text: XERAVA (eravacycline), a Type 1 NME 505(b)(1) NDA, received QIDP and Fast Track designations for cIAI/cUTI and was granted Priority review, receiving traditional approval based on two Phase 3 noninferiority trials in cIAI; no advisory committee was convened and no accelerated approval was used.
